name: haheho-mobile
description: Capacitor native shell for the Haheho AI patient/caregiver app (iOS + Android)

scripts.android:haheho: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew installHahehoDebug
scripts.android:inpatient: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew installInpatientDebug
scripts.release:android:haheho: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleHahehoRelease
scripts.release:android:inpatient: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleInpatientRelease
